base_reference: base Qwen with adapter disabled; actual W1 input tokens then candidate tokens, no question or bullet prefix
experiment_use: E17: both frozen E15-valid pairs averaged, all per-pair scores retained; no new validity gate.
nla_status: DESCRIPTIVE, continuation scoring off native explanation mode
notes: Frozen surface consequences may fail base validity; failed pairs/rows are reported, never reauthored after scores.
oracle_prompt: unchanged native Oracle prompt, no E6 continuation instruction appended
orientation: W1 value A positive, no sign reversal

list_depth.consequence: Next bullet at two versus four leading spaces; bullet text identical. This is a shallow/deep contrast, not an asserted perfect-level match.

prose_paren.consequence: Close an open parenthesis versus open a new parenthesis.

python_string.consequence: Close a double-quoted string versus leave it open / continue outside a string.

validity: Each pair valid iff base-reference dev AUROC>=0.80. Primary test score averages ONLY dev-valid pairs; zero-valid-pair rows NOT EVALUABLE. Report every pair separately; no replacement.
